YAYA Brand Design DNA: Core philosophy is lifestyle brand with soft feminine touch, elegant timeless pieces. Key colors: Deep charcoal rgb(28,25,23), warm cream rgb(243,241,238), signature brown rgb(80,64,45), scarlet red accent. Typography: Times New Roman for headlines, Neutraface Text for secondary, Helvetica for interface. Design principles: "kalme basis" (calm foundation), graceful silhouettes, understated Dutch elegance, warm approachable luxury. Style keywords: soft, feminine, comfortable, elegant, timeless. Visual approach: generous white space, minimal borders, subtle sophistication over bold statements.

Dashboard current state analysis: Good foundation with EB Garamond, YAYA classes, texture patterns, sophisticated glassmorphism cards.
